nodes.name: Webhook Trigger (Lead No Meeting)
nodes.notes: Triggered when a lead has no meeting scheduled. Expects JSON body with: lead_name, phone_number, lead_source, course_interest (optional)

nodes.name: Prepare & Validate Lead Data
nodes.notes: Validates phone number, formats for Exotel, prepares lead context

nodes.name: Exotel - Make Outbound Call
nodes.notes: Makes outbound call via Exotel. Lead's phone rings first, then connects to our agent handler webhook. Record=true for QA.

nodes.name: Store Call Context
nodes.notes: Stores call SID and lead context for conversation tracking

nodes.name: Call Handler Webhook (Exotel Streams Here)
nodes.notes: Exotel sends audio/speech to this webhook during the call. Receives: CallSid, From, To, RecordingUrl (if any), speech transcription

nodes.name: Sarvam AI - Speech to Text (Tamil)
nodes.notes: Transcribes Tamil/Tanglish speech from lead using Sarvam Saarika v2 model. Language: ta-IN (Tamil India)

nodes.name: Build GPT Message Context
nodes.notes: Builds conversation history, injects lead context into system prompt, prepares messages array for GPT-4

nodes.name: OpenAI GPT-4o-mini - Generate Response
nodes.notes: GPT-4o-mini generates the next Tanglish response. Using mini to keep costs low during testing (~$0.001 per call turn)

nodes.name: Process GPT Response
nodes.notes: Extracts speak text from GPT response, detects if call should end, updates conversation history

nodes.name: Sarvam AI - Text to Speech (Tamil Pavithra)
nodes.notes: Converts Priya's Tanglish response to audio using Sarvam Bulbul v1. Speaker: pavithra (natural Tamil female voice). 8000Hz sample rate optimized for phone calls.

nodes.name: Build Exotel XML Response
nodes.notes: Builds Exotel XML to play Sarvam audio on the call, then records next lead response. If call ending, adds Hangup tag.

nodes.name: Respond to Exotel (Play Audio)
nodes.notes: Sends XML back to Exotel to play Priya's voice response on the live call

nodes.name: Is Call Ending?
nodes.notes: Routes to save lead data if call is ending, otherwise continues the loop

nodes.name: Prepare Final Lead Record
nodes.notes: Prepares the final qualified lead record with all collected data

nodes.name: Save to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Saves qualified lead data to Google Sheets 'Qualified Leads' tab. Your sales team reads this to manually book Zoom meetings.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value: =Vanakkam {{ $json.lead_name }}! Social Eagle Academy-la irundhu pesinom. Ungal Zoom meeting details WhatsApp-la pathaikuvom. Doubts irundhalum 044-XXXXXXXX-la call pannunga. - Social Eagle Team

nodes.name: Send SMS Follow-up (If Meeting Agreed)
nodes.notes: Sends SMS to lead confirming call and that team will follow up with Zoom link. Only fires if zoom_meeting_agreed = true

nodes.name: Call Status Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives call status updates from Exotel: initiated, ringing, answered, completed, failed, busy, no-answer

nodes.name: Handle Call Status
nodes.notes: Processes Exotel status callbacks. Flags unanswered calls for retry (max 3 attempts)

main.node: Sarvam AI - Text to Speech (Tamil Pavithra)
